name: Skywrite
summary: A Send button whose paper plane winds up, loops through the sky and writes a mint trail
about: Press Send and the plane winds back, launches with speed streaks and flies a loop-the-loop that draws a glowing trail while the stars drift behind it. A ring around the icon fills as it flies, then a tick pops, sparks burst and a Delivered chip springs in. Good for contact forms, chat boxes and feedback widgets.
how: Hover: the plane bobs and a sheen sweeps across the button. Press: the button squashes and the plane pulls back.
On release the plane launches with speed streaks while the label rolls to Sending.
The plane loops through the sky drawing a mint trail with puffs, the stars drift and a ring around the icon fills as progress.
Delivery: a tick springs in, a ripple rolls out, sparks burst and a Delivered chip shows the time.
Reset: the trail slides away, the tick shrinks and the plane glides back into the button on a spring.
